description: The immutable release.flag asset for a producing component. The five-field kernel also admits interpreted components; env_sha and sha256 are optional producer-declared evidence, and optional lineage records the declared surface and its semantic-version movement.

sha256.description: 64-hex digest whose input the producing component declares in its own release documentation; for caduceus, the compact JSON of the per-profile digest map in publisher PROFILES order; for a single-binary component, that binary.

version.description: Strict major.minor.patch lineage version; the first release begins at 0.0.1.

surface_names.description: Declared surface names in sorted ascending order with no duplicates.

surface_sha256.description: SHA-256 of surface_names joined with LF and terminated by exactly one trailing LF.

derived_from.description: Previous release.flag source_sha; null for the first flag.

bump.description: initial for the first flag; disappearance or rename is major, additions-only is minor, and an unchanged surface is patch.

lineage.description: Optional declared-surface lineage; every nested field is optional for additive compatibility.

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Missing frozen kernel fields are refused; absent optional fields mean no evidence

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
